label: Test the quantitative grounding of the invariant non-rational chance rival
summary: Numerical completion of the invariant chance rival on theistG's two histories (result 725538ae, distributionGroundingControls). Every positive normalized binary pair gives a full-support law; two laws (1/8,7/8 and 3/8,5/8) share support, strict ranking and the tied-optimal output set; one calibrated mass, or full exchange symmetry, fixes a binary law by normalization; a two-element orbit with a singleton (Fin 3) leaves the orbit mass free; singleton versus indiscrete STIT cells over the same histories separate seeing to the giving or withholding from its mere occurrence. Finding: qualitative variation, support, ordinal ranking, tied optima and partial symmetry do not fix a quantitative law; calibration or full symmetry can, without making the effect deterministic. Strongest standing impersonal options: a necessary complete quantitative nature with a uniquely grounded nondegenerate law, a grounded structure inducing it, or a primitive necessary law as terminus; a contingent brute law survives only rejection or restriction of the contingent-fact PSR. The personal route explains contingent production without a selection probability but needs independent intellect/will warrant and faces the same reason demand for any contingent adoption. Consolidation (2026-11-28): the binary law now lives in the shared module TruthCore.Explanation.BinaryLaw (with its normalization lemmas), reused by #2151; records are generated from specs/will-versus-chance.toml. Lean build, binding and Comparator pass locally; independent semantic review pending.
blocker: The substantive bridge from the complete intrinsic nature of the necessary source to one grounded objective law, or from its non-rational powers to the impossibility of such a law, is not established. Next test: specify an objective chance law on complete outputs, identify its alleged ground in the simple source, and test uniqueness without building the law in as a parameter; contrast with independently warranted intentional direction.

current_assessment.assessment: A quantitative CHANCE_3 rival must add a calibrated mass or a full symmetry to determine its law; histories, support and strict ranking leave it open, and the tied-optimality clause is a constant-quality stand-in that constrains nothing. A contingent brute law and a contingent adoption with no admitted reason pay the same price under the contingent-fact PSR (#2151 lawSelectionFork clause 3). No premise discharged; DNP_inv neither supported nor refuted.
